project_metadata.name: Talus Trace
project_metadata.status: Refactor Phase: Implementing Atomic Twisted Pair & Component Library

ui_ux_rules.selection: Halo-based (child item). Do not modify parent geometry on select.
ui_ux_rules.wiring: Point-to-point. Pins are interactive sub-items. Wires are dynamic.
ui_ux_rules.twisted_pair: Atomic Entity. Deleting one end deletes the whole. No implicit handle; Explicit elbows only.

architecture_map.frontend: app.py (Entry), canvas.py (View), items.py (Basics), twisted_pair.py (New Atomic Impl)
architecture_map.backend: models.py (Pydantic Schemas), router.py (Pathing), library.py (New Component Mgr)

development_workflow.issue_tracking: python3 manage_issues.py (Move items to 'staging' for review).
development_workflow.environment_context: Desktop PySide6 App (Linux/VSCode). Direct hardware access.
